210: He went with him until they reached the great fire, of one angel named Sandalphon.  It was taught, Sandalphon was five hundred years taller than the rest of his companions.  And he stood behind the curtain of his Master, and weaves crowns from the prayers of Israel.  And in the moment that this crown reaches the head of the Holy King, He accepts the prayers of Israel.  And all of the legions and citizens of Heaven tremble and whisper and say "Blessed is the Glory of God from the place of the house of His Presence."
